# BalanceHeader

The account balance at the top of home and account screens, with a hide and show control.

## When to use

- Once per screen, at the top.

## When not to use

- Lists of balances: use AmountDisplay in rows.

## Anatomy

- Label, hide toggle, balance (AmountDisplay `xl`), meta line, optional actions.

## Content guidelines

- Label says which balance: "Available balance".
- Meta says how fresh it is: "Updated just now".

## Do

- Keep the toggle: people check balances in public.

## Don't

- Do not hide the label when the balance is hidden.

## Tokens

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-docs-tokens.ts from the compiled tokens. Do not edit this section by hand. -->

The balance uses `--lw-type-amount-xl`; the toggle is an sm IconButton.

Sizing and radius tokens. Change them in `packages/tokens/build/foundation.ts`; the component CSS reads only these.

| CSS variable | Leeward | Leeward Business | Refers to |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--lw-icon-button-size-xs` | 32 px | 28 px | `control.height.xs` |
| `--lw-icon-button-size-sm` | 36 px | 32 px | `control.height.sm` |
| `--lw-icon-button-size-md` | 44 px | 40 px | `control.height.md` |
| `--lw-icon-button-size-lg` | 48 px | 44 px | `control.height.lg` |
| `--lw-icon-button-radius` | 9999 px | 9999 px | `radius.pill` |

## Accessibility

- Region named by the label.
- The toggle uses `aria-pressed` and changes its label; hidden balances read "Balance hidden".

## Example

```tsx
import { BalanceHeader } from "@leeward/react";

export function HomeBalance() {
  return <BalanceHeader label="Available balance" balance={24580.35} currency="TRY" locale="tr-TR" meta="Updated just now" />;
}
```
